    Changelog

    STATS230 0.3.0 (Homework 3)

    New Features

    • Added function fit_logistic which uses three different optimization methods (Newton-Raphson (nr), Gradient Descent (gd), and Stochastic Gradient descent (sgd)) to compute MLEs for logistic regression coefficients.

    Documentation

    • Added vignette demonstrating the usage of fit_logistic and plotting/benchmarking convergence.

    STATS230 0.2.0 (Homework 2)

    New Features

    • Added function rmvnorm to generate random samples from the multivariate normal distribution.
    • Added function dmvnorm to compute the density of the multivariate normal distribution using either Cholesky or Eigen decomposition methods.
    • Added function my_lm to fit ordinary least squares regression models using Cholesky, QR, or SVD matrix decomposition methods.

    Documentation

    • Added vignette demonstrating the usage of rmvnorm, dmvnorm, and my_lm, along with benchmarking results comparing the computational efficiency of different methods for each function.

    STATS230 0.1.0 (Homework 1)

    New Features

    • Added function mult_ABx, which multiplies two square matrices and a vector. It has the option of using a more efficient method (A(Bx)) or a less efficient method ((AB)x).
    • Added function mult_Ainv_c, which computes the product of the inverse of a square matrix and a vector. It has the option of using a more efficient method (solve(A, c)) or a less efficient method (solve(A) %*% c).

    Documentation

    • Added vignette walking through the usage of mult_ABx and mult_Ainv_c, and comparing computational efficiency of two methods for each.
